papers.title: Methacrylated gelatin and mature adipocytes are promising components for adipose tissue engineering
papers.abstract: In vitro engineering of autologous fatty tissue constructs is still a major challenge for the treatment of congenital deformities, tumor resections or high-graded burns. In this study, we evaluated the suitability of photo-crosslinkable methacrylated gelatin (GM) and mature adipocytes as components for the composition of three-dimensional fatty tissue constructs. Cytocompatibility evaluations of the GM and the photoinitiator Lithium phenyl-2,4,6-trimethylbenzoylphosphinate (LAP) showed no cytotoxicity in the relevant range of concentrations. Matrix stiffness of cell-laden hydrogels was adjusted to native fatty tissue by tuning the degree of crosslinking and was shown to be comparable to that of native fatty tissue. Mature adipocytes were then cultured for 14 days within the GM resulting in a fatty tissue construct loaded with viable cells expressing cell markers perilipin A and laminin. This work demonstrates that mature adipocytes are a highly valuable cell source for the composition of fatty tissue equivalents in vitro. Photo-crosslinkable methacrylated gelatin is an excellent tissue scaffold and a promising bioink for new printing techniques due to its biocompatibility and tunable properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建自体脂肪组织移植物以治疗先天畸形或烧伤。
summary_zh.method: 使用甲基丙烯酰化明胶和成熟脂肪细胞制备三维脂肪组织构建物。
summary_zh.result: 构建物具有良好生物相容性，细胞标志物表达正常。
summary_zh.validation: 通过细胞活力和组织学分析验证构建物性能。

summary_en.motivation: To engineer autologous fatty tissue constructs for treating soft tissue defects.
summary_en.method: Photo-crosslinkable methacrylated gelatin (GM) was used to encapsulate mature adipocytes, and matrix stiffness was tuned to mimic native adipose tissue.
summary_en.result: Cell-laden GM hydrogels supported viable adipocytes expressing perilipin A and laminin over 14 days.
summary_en.validation: Cytocompatibility tests and mechanical characterization confirmed suitability for adipose tissue engineering.
